mostWorthwhile.text: Making rain over the rocky rise was most worthwhile: it connected wind, rising air and cooling to freshwater returning to the shore.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine reflected sunlight with the unprepared pool was frustrating because the failure did not explain what was missing.

surprise.text: The Moon first needed sunlight, and the pool then needed a separate nighttime preparation before it could show the reflection.

arbitrary.text: The need to prepare a still pool at night made sense afterward, but it was not clear why reflected sunlight could not be used with the tidal pools directly.

continue.text: I would continue: the chapter made natural processes understandable through a connected water cycle, and the final reflection provided a calm payoff.
